PARTNER_REPORT.TITLE: Partner inboxes
PARTNER_REPORT.DESCRIPTION: Unique messages, provider receipts and estimated unified-inbox costs.
PARTNER_REPORT.TIMEZONE_HELP: Enter the actual account timezone, such as America/Sao_Paulo. Without it, counts use UTC and the estimate is disabled.
PARTNER_REPORT.RATE_HELP: Enter your own rates. Blank means unknown; zero means no charge. These rates do not change sends or Meta prices.
PARTNER_REPORT.ERROR: Unable to generate the report. Check your filters and try again.

ERRORS.invalid_period: Choose a valid period of up to 366 days.
ERRORS.invalid_parameters: Check the dates, rates and filters.
ERRORS.invalid_rate: Rates must be nonnegative numbers up to 1,000,000.
ERRORS.period_too_large: More than 100,000 messages. Shorten the period or select one inbox pair.

PARTNER_REPORT.EMPTY: No partner inbox links found in this account.
PARTNER_REPORT.COUNTS_HELP: An inbound message observed by both providers counts as two provider receipts but only one unique message. Echoes, edits and deletions are not new sends. Missing transport evidence remains unidentified.
PARTNER_REPORT.DISCLAIMER: Estimate, not an invoice. Assumptions: 1,000 service messages per number/month, no rollover; an ad referral with source_id answered through Meta within 24 h starts the selected window. Seven-day eligibility depends on your WABA policy. This does not extend the 24-hour free-form messaging permission.
PARTNER_REPORT.TIME_BASIS: The estimate uses message creation time and available delivery confirmations. Missing category, transport or delivery timestamps may prevent invoice reconciliation. Rates vary by country and category; enter rates appropriate to your scenario.
PARTNER_REPORT.NO_TIMEZONE: Enter the WABA timezone to estimate the allowance reset at midnight on the first of each month.
PARTNER_REPORT.FREE_CUSTOMER_WINDOW: Free utility messages in customer window
PARTNER_REPORT.MONTHS: Monthly service usage through the end of the period
PARTNER_REPORT.MONTH_HELP: Includes usage from the first of the month, even when your filter starts later. The allowance is grouped by business number, not contact.
